title: Tri-brid Search Fusion with Balanced Merge for Knowledge Graphs

claims.assertion: Graph search retrieval requires a three-way candidate pool (dense vectors, sparse BM25, and BFS graph proximity) fused via Balanced Merge to prevent vector score dominance before cross-encoder reranking

context: Combining dense vector search with keyword and graph traversals frequently fails when raw similarity scores have divergent calibrations. Vector similarity scores cluster near 0.8-0.95, while BM25 outputs unbounded positive floats, causing one channel to starve candidate spots.
